name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
attention_variant: hybrid: linear attention with full attention every 4th layer (12 of 48)
notes: Largest and most aggressively sparse model in the Qwen line. Vendor card explains the odd 180B safetensors total: '125B with 6B activated, plus 51B n-gram embedding and 4B MTP' - so the transformer body is 125B and the rest is a large n-gram embedding table plus multi-token prediction heads. The 51B n-gram table is not per-token active FLOPs, which is why active_params_b is 6, not 180. kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 12 full-attention layers x 2 kv_heads x head_dim 256 x 2 x 2 = 12 x 2 x 256 x 2 x 2 = 24,576 B/token (24 KiB). layer_types over 48 layers: 36 linear_attention + 12 full_attention, full_attention_interval 4, linear_conv_kernel_dim 4, linear_num_value_heads 48. Same hybrid pattern as Qwen3.5 but with a 2:3 ratio... precisely, one full attention per 4 layers. MoE: 512 experts, 10 routed per token, PLUS a shared expert (shared_expert_intermediate_size 640). hidden 2560, moe_intermediate_size 640, gqa_ratio 12 (24 heads / 2 kv heads). Context 262144. rope_parameters: rope_type default, rope_theta 10000000, partial_rotary_factor 0.25, mrope_interleaved true with mrope_section [11,11,10] - a multimodal rotary scheme (mrope) rather than plain 1-D rope, which matters for multimodal serving. LICENSE is the bespoke 'Qwen Community License 1.0', a regression from Qwen3.5's Apache-2.0 - worth checking before adopting for commercial on-prem.
